decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 [email:7208d213], but six days of silence since: no reply to onboarding email, no invite sent, no tickets, and key_milestone still unreached with 8 days left. draft.subject: A quick hand getting River Studio moving in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Nice work getting your first project created last week. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step is usually getting a real piece of work in there and, if it's a shared effort, bringing someone else in -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how you want River Studio's work organized and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Chidi
